description: END-TO-END TEST for an automation. Enrolls a contact (created if it does not exist) into an ACTIVE workflow, waits briefly, then returns the per-step run log — which nodes ran, their outcomes, and where the contact is now waiting. Use this to prove a workflow actually works before telling the user it is done. Activate the workflow first with volanea_update_workflow { status: 'active' }.

email.description: Contact to enrol. Use the address from volanea_get_project_status `testInbox`. This tool CREATES the contact if it does not exist, so an invented address persists in the project — it is tagged as a test artifact and excluded from campaigns and segments, but a real, non-bouncing address is still the right input.

waitMs.description: How long to wait for steps to run before reading the log (default 750, max 5000).

name: volanea_test_workflow

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

contactId.description: The test contact used. Tagged as a test artifact and excluded from segments.

entered.description: False means the trigger did not match, or the workflow is not active.

steps.description: Each step the run executed, in order — the evidence that it worked.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
